description: Everything StringSpec has on one string, found by name (misspellings and missing gauges are fine): every measurement with its database percentile, elongation at 40, 51 and 62 lb, an estimated playable life, a tension adjustment versus the player's usual, how it ranks for each playing need (spin, comfort, control, power, tension hold, durability, feel), the closest alternatives, the retail price and a buy link. When the name matches several strings it returns the best match and lists the others.

name.description: The string's name, e.g. "Luxilon ALU Power 16L" or "RPM Blast".

name: get_string
title: Get one tennis string
